caseNameFull: Carter v. Woodring, Secretary of War
attorneys: Mr. Justice Black took no part in the consideration and decision of this application. Mr. Oberlin M. Carter, pro se. Solicitor General Reed, Assistant Attorney General Whitaker, and Mr. Paul A. Sweeney for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia denied.
